{id:"ex01",title:"Exercise 1",task:`Write a program that reads an integer <code>n</code> and displays the numbers from <code>1</code> to <code>n</code> and their square roots in two columns.<br><br><span class="small">Do not import a library for the square root; you can calculate it with exponentiation.</span>`,tests:[[["4"],["1 1","2 1.414","3 1.732","4 2"]],[["2"],["1 1","2 1.414"]]],need:["input","loop","print"],match:"rootpairs"},

Then display the user's full name with <strong>all characters in reverse order</strong>.<br><br><span class="small">Example: <code>John White</code> → monogram <code>Jote</code>; reversed full name <code>etihW nhoJ</code>.</span>`,tests:[[["John","White"],["jo","te","etihw nhoj"]],[["Anna","Brown"],["an","wn","nworb anna"]]],need:["input","print"],match:"allcontains"},

let pyodide=null, active=null, lastTick=Date.now();

function key(id){return "pycourse_week04_"+id}
function state(id){return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key(id))||'{"code":"","time":0,"runs":0,"checks":0,"hints":0,"completed":false,"started":false}')}
function save(id,o){localStorage.setItem(key(id),JSON.stringify(o))}
function fmt(s){s=Math.floor(s);return String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,"0")+":"+String(s%60).padStart(2,"0")}
function renderSummary(){
 let cells=EX.map(e=>{let s=state(e.id),status=s.completed?"✓ Completed":s.started?"In progress / paused":"Not started";return `<div>${e.title}</div><div>${status}</div><div>${fmt(s.time)}</div><div>${s.runs}</div><div>${s.checks}</div><div>${s.hints}</div>`}).join("");
 let total=EX.reduce((a,e)=>a+state(e.id).time,0), done=EX.filter(e=>state(e.id).completed).length;
 document.getElementById("summary").innerHTML=`<section class="ex"><h2>Week 4 summary</h2><div><strong>Completed:</strong> ${done} / ${EX.length} &nbsp; · &nbsp; <strong>Total active time:</strong> ${fmt(total)}</div><div class="summary-grid"><div class="summary-head">Exercise</div><div class="summary-head">Status</div><div class="summary-head">Active time</div><div class="summary-head">Runs</div><div class="summary-head">Checks</div><div class="summary-head">Hints</div>${cells}</div></section>`;
}

function validNeptun(v){return /^[A-Z0-9]{6}$/.test((v||"").trim().toUpperCase())}
function getNeptun(){return (localStorage.getItem("pycourse_neptun")||"").trim().toUpperCase()}
function setNeptunUI(){
 const box=document.getElementById("neptun-code"),msg=document.getElementById("neptun-message");
 if(!box)return;
 const n=getNeptun(),ok=validNeptun(n); box.value=n;
 msg.textContent=ok?`Neptun code saved: ${n}`:"Enter your 6-character Neptun code before starting the exercises.";
 document.querySelectorAll("[id$='-start']").forEach(b=>b.disabled=COURSE_CONFIG.requireNeptun&&!ok);
}
function saveNeptun(){
 const box=document.getElementById("neptun-code"),msg=document.getElementById("neptun-message");
 const n=(box.value||"").trim().toUpperCase(); box.value=n;
 if(!validNeptun(n)){msg.textContent="Please enter a valid 6-character Neptun code.";return}
 localStorage.setItem("pycourse_neptun",n); setNeptunUI();

// Code editor: TAB inserts four spaces and saves the source.
document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  const el=e.target;
  if(!(el instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) || !el.classList.contains("code") || e.key!=="Tab") return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const start=el.selectionStart, end=el.selectionEnd, indent="    ";
  el.value=el.value.substring(0,start)+indent+el.value.substring(end);
  el.selectionStart=el.selectionEnd=start+indent.length;
  const id=el.id.replace(/-code$/,"");
  if(id) persistCode(id);
});

}

function render(){
 list.innerHTML=EX.map(e=>{let s=state(e.id);return `<section class="ex" id="${e.id}">
 <div class="head"><div><h2>${e.title}</h2><div>${e.task}</div></div><div class="status" id="${e.id}-status">${s.completed?"✓ Completed":s.started?"Paused":"Not started"} · <span class="timer">${fmt(s.time)}</span></div></div>
 <div class="controls"><button id="${e.id}-start" onclick="startEx('${e.id}')">${s.started?"Continue exercise":"Start exercise"}</button></div>
 <div class="workspace" id="${e.id}-ws">
 <div class="small">Active time: <strong class="timer" id="${e.id}-time">${fmt(s.time)}</strong> · Runs: <span id="${e.id}-runs">${s.runs}</span> · Checks: <span id="${e.id}-checks">${s.checks}</span> · Hints: <span id="${e.id}-hints">${s.hints}</span></div>
 <p><strong>Your Python code</strong></p><textarea class="code" id="${e.id}-code" spellcheck="false">${esc(s.code)}</textarea>
 <div class="controls"><button onclick="runEx('${e.id}')">▶ Run</button><button onclick="checkEx('${e.id}')">✓ Check my solution</button><button onclick="hintEx('${e.id}')">💡 Hint</button><button onclick="stopEx('${e.id}')">■ Stop</button></div>
 <strong>Output</strong><pre id="${e.id}-out"></pre><div class="checkpanel" id="${e.id}-panel">No check has been run yet.</div></div></section>`}).join("");
 renderSummary();
}
function esc(x){return x.replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;")}
async function ensurePy(){if(!pyodide){document.title="Loading Python…";pyodide=await loadPyodide();document.title="Class Exercises 4 – Loops in Python"}}
async function startEx(id){
 if(!document.getElementById("rules-accepted")?.checked){
   alert("Please confirm that you understand and accept the programming rules before starting.");
   return;
 }
 if(COURSE_CONFIG.requireNeptun&&!validNeptun(getNeptun())){
   document.getElementById("neptun-message").textContent="Save a valid Neptun code before starting an exercise.";
   document.getElementById("neptun-code").focus(); return;
 }
 if(active&&active!==id) stopEx(active);
 let s=state(id);
 document.querySelectorAll(".workspace").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));
 document.getElementById(id+"-ws").classList.add("active");
 document.getElementById(id+"-code").value=s.code;
 if(!s.completed){
   active=id; s.started=true; save(id,s); lastTick=Date.now();
 } else {
   active=null; // review does not add to completion time
 }
 await ensurePy(); updateStatus(id);
}
function persistCode(id){let s=state(id),el=document.getElementById(id+"-code");if(el)s.code=el.value;save(id,s)}
function stopEx(id){if(active===id){tick();persistCode(id);active=null} document.getElementById(id+"-ws").classList.remove("active");updateStatus(id)}
function tick(){let now=Date.now();if(active&&!document.hidden){let s=state(active);s.time+=(now-lastTick)/1000;save(active,s);let el=document.getElementById(active+"-time");if(el)el.textContent=fmt(s.time)}lastTick=now;renderSummary()}
setInterval(tick,1000);document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{tick();lastTick=Date.now()});
window.addEventListener("beforeunload",()=>{tick();if(active)persistCode(active)});
function updateStatus(id){
 let s=state(id),el=document.getElementById(id+"-status"),btn=document.getElementById(id+"-start");
 if(el)el.innerHTML=(s.completed?"✓ Completed":active===id?"In progress":s.started?"Paused":"Not started")+" · <span class='timer'>"+fmt(s.time)+"</span>";
 if(btn)btn.textContent=s.completed?"Review solution":s.started?"Continue exercise":"Start exercise";
 renderSummary();
}
async function execute(code,inputs,interactive=false,onOutput=null){
 await ensurePy();pyodide.globals.set("student_code",code);pyodide.globals.set("student_inputs_json",JSON.stringify(inputs.map(String)));
 pyodide.globals.set("student_interactive",interactive);
 pyodide.globals.set("student_prompt",(message)=>window.prompt(message || "Enter a value:"));
 pyodide.globals.set("student_output",(chunk)=>{if(onOutput)onOutput(String(chunk));});
 let x=await pyodide.runPythonAsync(`
import json,builtins,io,contextlib
def _run(src, vals):
    it=iter(json.loads(vals)); out=io.StringIO()
    class LiveOutput(io.TextIOBase):
        def write(self, text):
            out.write(text)
            student_output(text)
            return len(text)
        def flush(self):
            pass
    live=LiveOutput()
    def inp(prompt=""):
        if student_interactive:
            value=student_prompt(str(prompt))
            if value is None:
                raise EOFError("Input cancelled.")
        else:
            try:
                value=next(it)
            except StopIteration:
                raise EOFError("No more input values.")
        if prompt:
            print(prompt,end="")
        print(value)
        return value
    old=builtins.input
    try:
        builtins.input=inp
        ns={"__name__":"__main__"}
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(live if student_interactive else out),contextlib.redirect_stderr(live if student_interactive else out):
            exec(compile(src,"<student_code>","exec"),ns,ns)
        return json.dumps({"ok":True,"output":out.getvalue().strip()})
    except Exception as e:return json.dumps({"ok":False,"output":out.getvalue().strip(),"error":type(e).__name__+": "+str(e)})
    finally:builtins.input=old
_run(student_code,student_inputs_json)
`);return JSON.parse(String(x))
}
async function structure(code){
 pyodide.globals.set("student_code",code);let x=await pyodide.runPythonAsync(`
import ast,json
def _st(src):
 t=ast.parse(src)
 calls=[n for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n,ast.Call)]
 imports=[]
 for n in ast.walk(t):
  if isinstance(n,ast.Import): imports += [a.name for a in n.names]
  elif isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom) and n.module: imports.append(n.module)
 fors=[n for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n,ast.For)]
 whiles=[n for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n,ast.While)]
 forbidden=[type(n).__name__.lower() for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n,(ast.Break,ast.Continue,ast.Return))]
 comprehensions=any(isinstance(n,(ast.ListComp,ast.SetComp,ast.DictComp,ast.GeneratorExp)) for n in ast.walk(t))
 shortcut_names={"sum","min","max","any","all","sorted","enumerate","zip"}
 shortcuts=[n.func.id for n in calls if isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id in shortcut_names]
 methods=[n.func.attr for n in calls if isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and not (isinstance(n.func.value,ast.Name) and n.func.value.id=="random")]
 while_has_and=any(isinstance(n.test,ast.BoolOp) and isinstance(n.test.op,ast.And) for n in whiles)
 return json.dumps({
 "input":any(isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=="input" for n in ast.walk(t)),
 "if":any(isinstance(n,ast.If) for n in ast.walk(t)),
 "comparison":any(isinstance(n,ast.Compare) for n in ast.walk(t)),
 "loop":bool(fors or whiles),
 "for":bool(fors),"while":bool(whiles),"while_has_and":while_has_and,
 "print":any(isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=="print" for n in ast.walk(t)),
 "random":any(name=="random" for name in imports),
 "imports":imports,"forbidden":forbidden,"comprehensions":comprehensions,
 "shortcuts":shortcuts,"methods":methods,
 "collections":{
   "list":any(isinstance(n,ast.List) for n in ast.walk(t)),
   "tuple":any(isinstance(n,ast.Tuple) for n in ast.walk(t)),
   "set":any(isinstance(n,ast.Set) for n in ast.walk(t)),
   "dict":any(isinstance(n,ast.Dict) for n in ast.walk(t)),
   "constructors":[n.func.id for n in calls if isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id in {"list","tuple","set","dict"}]
 }
 })
_st(student_code)
`);return JSON.parse(String(x))
}
function inputPrompts(code){
 // Extract simple input("prompt") / input('prompt') calls in source order.
 const rx=/input\s*\(\s*(?:(["'])(.*?)\1)?\s*\)/g;
 let a=[],m; while((m=rx.exec(code))!==null)a.push(m[2]||"Enter a value:");
 return a;
}
async function runEx(id){
 let s=state(id),code=document.getElementById(id+"-code").value;
 s.code=code;s.runs++;save(id,s);document.getElementById(id+"-runs").textContent=s.runs;
 const output=document.getElementById(id+"-out");
 output.textContent="";
 let r=await execute(code,[],true,chunk=>{output.textContent+=chunk;output.scrollTop=output.scrollHeight});
 output.textContent=r.ok?r.output:(r.output?r.output+"\n":"")+r.error
}
function numbersInLine(line){
 return (line.match(/[-+]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)/g)||[]).map(Number)
}
function rootPairsMatch(out,inputs){
 const n=Number(inputs[0]), lines=out.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
 for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){
   const root=Math.sqrt(i);
   const ok=lines.some(line=>{
     const nums=numbersInLine(line);
     return nums.length>=2 && Math.abs(nums[0]-i)<1e-9 && Math.abs(nums[1]-root)<0.01;
   });
   if(!ok)return false;
 }
 return true;
}
function matches(e,out,expected,inputs=[]){
 let o=out.trim().toLowerCase();
 if(e.match==="structure") return false;
 if(e.match==="rootpairs") return rootPairsMatch(out,inputs);
 if(e.match==="allcontains"){
   let vals=Array.isArray(expected)?expected:[expected];
   return vals.every(v=>o.includes(String(v).toLowerCase()));
 }
 if(e.match==="quadratic"){if(Array.isArray(expected))return expected.every(v=>o.includes(v));return o.includes("no real")||o.includes("no solution")}
 if(e.match==="ends")return o.endsWith(String(expected).toLowerCase());
 return o.includes(String(expected).toLowerCase())
}
function algorithmicCheck(id,st){
 const problems=[], policy=WEEK04_POLICY[id]||{}, cols=st.collections||{};
 const usedCollections=[cols.list?"list":null,cols.tuple?"tuple":null,cols.set?"set":null,cols.dict?"dictionary":null,...(cols.constructors||[])].filter(Boolean);
 if(usedCollections.length) problems.push("Complex data structures are not allowed in this exercise: "+[...new Set(usedCollections)].join(", ")+".");
 if(st.forbidden?.length) problems.push("Use structured control flow: do not use break, continue, or return.");
 if(st.comprehensions) problems.push("Do not use comprehensions in these exercises.");
 if(st.shortcuts?.length) problems.push("Do not use Python shortcut functions such as "+st.shortcuts.join(", ")+".");
 if(st.methods?.length) problems.push("Do not use later method-based shortcuts in this exercise.");
 const allowedImports=policy.allowed_imports||[];
 const badImports=(st.imports||[]).filter(x=>!allowedImports.includes(x));
 if(badImports.length) problems.push("This exercise does not allow the imported module(s): "+badImports.join(", ")+".");
 if((policy.required||[]).includes("random")&&!st.random) problems.push("This exercise requires the random module.");
 if((policy.required||[]).includes("while")&&!st.while) problems.push("This task requires a condition-controlled while loop.");
 if((policy.forbidden_extra||[]).includes("for")&&st.for) problems.push("Do not use a for loop in this exercise; use the required while loop.");
 if(id==="ex03"&&!st.while_has_and) problems.push("The prime test must express early stopping directly in the while condition.");
 if(id==="ex07"){
   if(!st.for) problems.push("Use a for loop to examine the numbers in the interval.");
   if(!st.while) problems.push("Use a condition-controlled while loop for the inner prime test.");
   if(st.while&&!st.while_has_and) problems.push("The inner prime test must stop as soon as the result is known; express this in the while condition.");
 }
 return problems;
}
async function assessExercise(id,updateUI=true){
 let e=EX.find(x=>x.id===id),s=state(id),el=document.getElementById(id+"-code"),code=el?el.value:s.code;
 if(el){s.code=code;save(id,s)}
 let result={id,syntax:false,structure:false,rules:false,functional:false,passed:0,total:e.tests.length,problems:[],missing:[],runtime:null};
 // Empty and print-only placeholders are not meaningful solutions.
 const normalizedCode=(code||"").trim();
 const trivialPrint=/^print\s*\(\s*(?:(?:["'][^"']*["'])|\s*)\s*\)\s*;?\s*$/s.test(normalizedCode);
 if(!normalizedCode || trivialPrint){
   result.syntax=!!normalizedCode;
   result.structure=false; result.rules=false; result.functional=false; result.passed=0;
   result.problems=[!normalizedCode ? "No solution has been entered yet." : "A print-only placeholder does not solve this exercise."];
   if(updateUI){const panel=document.getElementById(id+"-panel");if(panel)panel.innerHTML="<span class='bad'>✗ Not completed.</span><br>"+result.problems.map(esc).join("<br>");}
   return result;
 }

 try{
   await ensurePy(); let st=await structure(code); result.syntax=true;
   result.missing=e.need.filter(n=>!st[n]); result.structure=result.missing.length===0;
   result.problems=algorithmicCheck(id,st); result.rules=result.problems.length===0;
   let rows=[],passed=0;
   for(let t of e.tests){
     let inputs=Array.isArray(t[0])?t[0]:[String(t[0])],r=await execute(code,inputs);
     if(!r.ok){result.runtime=r.error;break}
     let ok=matches(e,r.output,t[1],inputs);if(ok)passed++;
     rows.push({inputs,exp:t[1],got:r.output,ok})
   }
   result.passed=passed;result.rows=rows;
   result.functional=e.match==="structure" ? true : (passed===e.tests.length);
   result.completed=result.syntax&&result.structure&&result.rules&&result.functional&&!result.runtime;
   if(updateUI){
     let panel=document.getElementById(id+"-panel");
     panel.innerHTML="<div class='ok'>✓ Syntax</div>"+
       "<div class='"+(result.structure?"ok":"bad")+"'>"+(result.structure?"✓":"✗")+" Expected structure</div>"+
       "<div class='"+(result.rules?"ok":"bad")+"'>"+(result.rules?"✓":"✗")+" Algorithmic structure</div>"+
       (result.problems.length?result.problems.map(p=>"<div class='bad'>• "+esc(p)+"</div>").join(""):"")+
       (result.runtime?"<div class='bad'>✗ Runtime: "+esc(result.runtime)+"</div>":
        "<div class='"+(result.functional?"ok":"bad")+"'>"+(result.functional?"✓":"✗")+" "+(e.match==="structure"?"Functional behaviour checked by structure":"Functional tests: "+passed+" / "+e.tests.length)+"</div>")+
       rows.map(r=>"<div class='"+(r.ok?"ok":"bad")+"'>"+(r.ok?"✓":"✗")+" input "+esc(r.inputs.join(", "))+" → "+(r.ok?"passed":"output did not meet the task requirements · got: "+esc(r.got||"(no output)"))+"</div>").join("");
     if(result.completed){
       tick();s=state(id);s.completed=true;s.code=code;save(id,s);
       panel.innerHTML+="<div class='hint'><strong>✓ Exercise completed.</strong> Active time: "+fmt(s.time)+". The timer has stopped automatically.</div>";
       if(active===id)active=null;updateStatus(id);
     }
   }
 }catch(err){result.runtime=String(err);if(updateUI)document.getElementById(id+"-panel").innerHTML="<div class='bad'>✗ Checker error</div><div>"+esc(String(err))+"</div>"}
 return result;
}
async function checkEx(id){
 let s=state(id);s.checks++;save(id,s);document.getElementById(id+"-checks").textContent=s.checks;
 await assessExercise(id,true);
}

async function evaluateWork(){
 tick();
 const btn=document.getElementById("evaluate-work"),box=document.getElementById("evaluation-result");
 btn.disabled=true;box.innerHTML="<p>Evaluating current solutions…</p>";
 const results=[];
 for(const e of EX){
   const s=state(e.id);
   if(!s.started && !s.code.trim()){results.push({id:e.id,attempted:false,completed:false});continue}
   const r=await assessExercise(e.id,false);r.attempted=true;results.push(r);
 }
 const attempted=results.filter(r=>r.attempted), completed=results.filter(r=>r.completed);
 const functional=attempted.filter(r=>r.functional).length, rules=attempted.filter(r=>r.rules&&r.structure).length;
 let points=0;
 for(const r of results){
   if(!r.attempted)continue;
   points += (r.functional?0.6:0)+(r.structure?0.2:0)+(r.rules?0.2:0);
 }
 const score=Math.round(100*points/EX.length);
 const suggestions=[];
 if(attempted.length<EX.length)suggestions.push("Continue with the exercises that have not been attempted yet.");
 if(functional<attempted.length)suggestions.push("Review the task requirements for exercises whose functional tests do not pass.");
 if(rules<attempted.length)suggestions.push("Review loop choice and structured control flow. Avoid break, continue, and return as loop-control shortcuts.");
 if(results.some(r=>r.problems?.some(p=>p.includes("condition-controlled while"))))suggestions.push("For search-style tasks, use a while condition that stops the search as soon as the result is known.");
 if(!suggestions.length)suggestions.push("Your current solutions satisfy the deterministic checks. Try explaining why each task uses for or while.");
 const no=(Number(localStorage.getItem("pycourse_week04_evaluation_no")||"0")+1);
 localStorage.setItem("pycourse_week04_evaluation_no",String(no));

 const payload={
   schema_version:"1.0",
   week:"04",
   neptun:getNeptun(),
   evaluation_no:no,
   evaluated_at:new Date().toISOString(),
   indicative_score:score,
   summary:{attempted:attempted.length,completed:completed.length,functional_passed:functional,rules_passed:rules,total:EX.length},
   exercises:EX.map(e=>{
     const s=state(e.id),r=results.find(x=>x.id===e.id)||{};
     return {
       exercise_id:e.id,
       source_code:(document.getElementById(e.id+"-code")?.value ?? s.code ?? ""),
       started:!!s.started,
       active_time_seconds:Math.round(s.time||0),
       run_count:s.runs||0,
       check_count:s.checks||0,
       hint_count:s.hints||0,
       attempted:!!r.attempted,
       completed:!!r.completed,
       syntax:!!r.syntax,
       structure:!!r.structure,
       rules:!!r.rules,
       functional:!!r.functional,
       rule_violations:r.problems||[]
     };
   })
 };

 let uploadMessage="<span class='small'>Saving learning analytics to Azure…</span>";
 box.innerHTML=`<div class="hint"><strong>Indicative evaluation: ${score}%</strong><br>
 ${completed.length} / ${EX.length} exercises currently completed successfully.<br>
 Functional correctness: ${functional} / ${attempted.length||0} attempted.<br>
 Programming and algorithmic rules: ${rules} / ${attempted.length||0} attempted.<br>
 <strong>This evaluation is for feedback only and does not count toward your course grade.</strong>
 <br><br><strong>Suggestions</strong><ul>${suggestions.map(x=>"<li>"+esc(x)+"</li>").join("")}</ul>
 <span class="small">Evaluation #${no}. You can improve your solutions and evaluate again.</span><br>
 <span id="practice-upload-status">${uploadMessage}</span></div>`;
 renderSummary();document.getElementById("summary").style.display="block";

 try{
   if(!validNeptun(payload.neptun)) throw new Error("A valid Neptun code is required.");
   const resp=await fetch(PRACTICE_API_BASE+"/submitPractice",{
     method:"POST",
     headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
     body:JSON.stringify(payload)
   });
   const data=await resp.json().catch(()=>({}));
   if(!resp.ok) throw new Error(data.error||("HTTP "+resp.status));
   document.getElementById("practice-upload-status").innerHTML="✓ Learning analytics saved successfully.";
 }catch(err){
   document.getElementById("practice-upload-status").innerHTML="⚠ Evaluation completed locally, but the analytics upload failed: "+esc(String(err.message||err));
 }
 btn.disabled=false;
}
function hintEx(id){let s=state(id);s.hints=Math.min(s.hints+1,3);save(id,s);document.getElementById(id+"-hints").textContent=s.hints;let e=EX.find(x=>x.id===id);let hints={
ex01:["Use a loop that visits every integer from 1 to n.","The square root of x can be calculated as x ** 0.5.","Print the number and its square root during each iteration."],
ex02:["You need an accumulator variable for the sum.","A range can generate only odd numbers if its step is 2.","Start from 1 and repeatedly add the current odd value to the sum."],
ex03:["A prime number greater than 1 has no divisor other than 1 and itself.","Generate n with the random module, then test possible divisors in a loop.","If you find a divisor before reaching n, the number is not prime."],
ex04:["Start with denomination 1000 and repeatedly move to the next smaller denomination.","Integer division tells you how many pieces are needed; remainder gives the cash still to convert.","After processing a denomination, divide it by 10 to get 100, 10, and 1."],
ex05:["Generate the target once before the guessing loop.","The loop must stop after at most 8 attempts or when the guess is correct.","After an incorrect guess, compare it with the target and tell the user to go higher or lower."],
ex06:["Strings can be indexed and sliced.","Use the first two characters of the first name and the last two of the last name.","A slice with a step of -1 reverses a string."],
ex07:["Use an outer loop to examine every number between a and b.","For each candidate, use another loop to check whether it has a divisor.","Print the candidate only if no divisor proves that it is composite."]
};document.getElementById(id+"-panel").innerHTML+="<div class='hint'><strong>Hint "+s.hints+":</strong> "+hints[id][s.hints-1]+"</div>"}
render();
document.getElementById("save-neptun")?.addEventListener("click",saveNeptun);
document.getElementById("neptun-code")?.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter")saveNeptun()});
document.getElementById("neptun-code")?.addEventListener("input",e=>{e.target.value=e.target.value.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,"").slice(0,6)});
setNeptunUI();

</script>
